fact: The national addressing procedure guide (NA Guide 00-08:2023) was adopted as an Algerian standard in March 2023 and requires locating every building, including housing in scattered or isolated areas, and entering addresses in the national addressing reference platform.
title: المرجع الوطني للعنونة (Guide NA 00-08:2023, Référentiel National d'Adressage)
publisher: Ministère de l'Intérieur, des Collectivités locales et de l'Aménagement du Territoire
